name: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 - Path Traversal and RCE (incomplete fix)
description: The fix for CVE-2021-41773 in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 was insufficient. An attacker can still use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the document root, and achieve RCE where CGI is enabled.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later.
